messages:
Ivy (AE): Customer (CapitalGrid) asks: POC for Private deploy. Must preserve client src IP for fraud scoring, allowlist a single /28, and prefer minimal route changes. Can we meet this?
Marco (Solutions): Two options: (1) Connector-in-VPC (best for srcIP + BYOIP egress). (2) PrivateLink interface endpoint — minimal routing, ENIs in their subnets; note control-plane egress still comes from Redwood EIPs unless connector is customer-hosted.
Jess (NetOps): If they need a single /28 allowlist, we can provide our egress EIP block during onboarding. Warning: if we SNAT to that EIP, original srcIP will be lost at their app. To preserve srcIP, customer must run the connector inside their VPC or use a passthrough L4 proxy in their account.
Priya (Security): Quick paste for questionnaire:
"Network Architecture (Private): Option A: Customer-hosted connector deployed in their VPC. App traffic routes to connector; outbound TLS (443) from connector to Redwood control-plane. Preserves client source IP. Option B: PrivateLink via Interface Endpoint. ENIs created in customer subnets; minimal route changes. Firewall: allow outbound TCP/443 to Redwood control-plane EIP range (provided during onboarding) and update SGs to permit app->endpoint TLS. No public inbound exposure required."
Ivy (AE): They also reported occasional truncated responses (suspect MTU). Any quick ask for their network team?
Jess (NetOps): Ask them: SD-WAN/VPN MTU value. Recommend MSS clamp on connector or SD-WAN side. Example iptables rule: 
iptables -t mangle -A POSTROUTING -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu
Marco (Solutions): Pricing note for AE/procurement: small POC with customer-hosted connector includes onboarding fee + monthly connector charge; ballpark ~1.2x hosted cost for limited trial. HA or multi-region adds infra line items. I'll follow up with exact SKU.
deploy-bot: POC workspace provisioned: redwood-poc-capitalgrid-2026 (id poc-cg01). Link: https://internal.redwood/pocs/poc-cg01
Ivy (AE): Great — I'll send the security blurb and SG snippet to their infra lead and request SD-WAN MTU. Thanks team.
